jobs.description:
Your team

PWM Customized Solutions team enables business innovation within Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) by helping business users leverage modern technologies, including AI, low-code platforms, and data solutions. The team acts as a bridge between business needs and technology teams, delivering or enabling innovative and compliant solutions that create tangible business value.

Internship Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated student to join the Customized Solutions team for a 12-month internship focused on the design and implementation of PWM's next-generation Agentic AI Platform.

This strategic initiative aims to provide business users with secure, scalable, and governed AI agents capable of supporting knowledge discovery, process automation, decision support, and productivity enhancement across PWM.

The intern will contribute to both the research and implementation aspects of the platform, combining academic work with practical delivery in a real-world banking environment.

Your role

Agentic AI Platform Strategy and Architecture

• Evaluate emerging AI agent technologies, frameworks, and patterns.

• Collaborate with business, IT, security, and data teams to define requirements.

• Support the design of secure, scalable, and reusable platform components.

Governance and Risk Management

• Identify policies, standards, and control mechanisms for responsible AI adoption.

• Help define monitoring, auditability, security, and compliance requirements.

• Research best practices related to AI governance in highly regulated environments.

Platform Implementation

• Participate in the development and configuration of AI agents.

• Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts addressing real business use cases.

• Integrating AI capabilities with enterprise data sources and business applications.

Research and Innovation

• Conduct academic research related to agentic AI systems and enterprise AI platforms.

• Evaluate industry trends and benchmark solutions adopted within the financial services sector.

• Translate research findings into practical recommendations and platform improvements.

Expected Deliverables

• Design recommendations for the PWM Agentic AI Platform architecture.

• AI governance framework proposals and implementation guidelines.

• Prototypes of AI agents addressing business use cases and technical documentation.

Your profile

Education

• Computer Science or Software Engineering

• Artificial Intelligence

• Data Science

• Or a related discipline

Technical Skills

• Understanding AI and LLMs.

• Knowledge of software architecture concepts.

• Familiarity with cloud technologies, APIs, and programming languages.

• Interest in AI governance, and security.

Personal Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies.

• Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

• Autonomous, organized, and collaborative mindset.

What the Intern Will Gain

• Hands-on experience building an enterprise-grade AI platform in a leading private bank.

• Exposure to cutting-edge Agentic AI technologies and governance practices.

• Opportunity to collaborate with experts across technology, security, data, and business domains.

• Ability to transform academic research into tangible business impact.

• Participate in a highly strategic initiative shaping the future use of AI within Wealth Management.

Start date: February / March 2027

This opportunity is intended for students completing a Master’s thesis required by their academic programme. Only candidates whose Master’s degree requires an internship are eligible to apply.

Ref: MTCS/RS/LMM

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

La tua squadra

Il team di PWM Custom Solutions consente l'innovazione aziendale all'interno di Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) aiutando gli utenti aziendali a sfruttare le tecnologie moderne, tra cui AI, piattaforme di basso codice e soluzioni di dati. Il team funge da ponte tra le esigenze aziendali e i team tecnologici, fornendo o abilitando soluzioni innovative e conformi che creano un valore aziendale tangibile.

Panoramica di stage

Stiamo cercando uno studente altamente motivato per unire il team di soluzioni personalizzate per uno stage di 12 mesi focalizzato sulla progettazione e l'implementazione della piattaforma AI Agentic di prossima generazione di PWM.

Questa iniziativa strategica mira a fornire agli utenti aziendali agenti AI sicuri, scalabili e regolamentati in grado di supportare la scoperta della conoscenza, l'automazione dei processi, il supporto decisionale e la valorizzazione della produttività attraverso PWM.

Lo stage contribuirà sia agli aspetti di ricerca che di attuazione della piattaforma, combinando il lavoro accademico con la consegna pratica in un ambiente bancario reale.

Il tuo ruolo

Strategia e architettura della piattaforma AI

• Valutare le tecnologie, i framework e i modelli di agenti AI emergenti.

• Collabora con i team aziendali, IT, sicurezza e dati per definire i requisiti.

• Supporta la progettazione di componenti di piattaforma sicuri, scalabili e riutilizzabili.

Governance e gestione dei rischi

• Identificare politiche, standard e meccanismi di controllo per l'adozione di AI responsabile.

• Aiuta a definire i requisiti di monitoraggio, verificabilità, sicurezza e conformità.

• Le migliori pratiche di ricerca legate alla governance dell'IA in ambienti altamente regolamentati.

Attuazione della piattaforma

• Partecipa allo sviluppo e alla configurazione degli agenti AI.

• Costruire prototipi e prove-di-concetti che affrontano casi reali di uso aziendale.

• Integrare le funzionalità AI con fonti di dati aziendali e applicazioni aziendali.

Ricerca e innovazione

• Condurre ricerche accademiche relative a sistemi AI agentici e piattaforme AI enterprise.

• Valutare le tendenze del settore e le soluzioni di riferimento adottate nel settore dei servizi finanziari.

• Tradurre i risultati di ricerca in raccomandazioni pratiche e miglioramenti della piattaforma.

Fornitori previsti

• Raccomandazioni di progettazione per l'architettura PWM Agentic AI Platform.

• Proposte quadro di governance AI e linee guida per l'attuazione.

• Prototipi degli agenti dell'IA che affrontano casi di uso commerciale e documentazione tecnica.

Il tuo profilo

Istruzione

• Scienza informatica o ingegneria software

• Intelligenza artificiale

• Scienza dei dati

• O una disciplina correlata

Competenze tecniche

• Comprendere AI e LLM.

• Conoscenza dei concetti di architettura del software.

• Familiarità con tecnologie cloud, API e linguaggi di programmazione.

• L'interesse per la governance dell'AI e la sicurezza.

Competenze personali

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• Curiosità e disponibilità ad imparare le tecnologie emergenti.

• Capacità di comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder tecnici e aziendali.

• Mindset autonomo, organizzato e collaborativo.

Che cosa porterà l'Interno

• Esperienza pratica costruzione di una piattaforma AI di livello aziendale in una banca privata leader.

• Esposizione a tecnologie e pratiche di governance dell'AI Agentic all'avanguardia.

• Opportunità di collaborare con esperti in tecnologia, sicurezza, dati e settori aziendali.

• Capacità di trasformare la ricerca accademica in impatto commerciale tangibile.

• Partecipa a un'iniziativa altamente strategica che definisce l'uso futuro dell'IA all'interno della Wealth Management.

Data di inizio: febbraio / marzo 2027

Ref: MTCS/RS/LMM

Dein Team

Das Team von PWM Customized Solutions ermöglicht Geschäftsinnovationen innerhalb von Pictet Wealth Management (PWM), indem es Geschäftsanwendern hilft, moderne Technologien wie KI, Low-Code-Plattformen und Datenlösungen zu nutzen. Das Team fungiert als Brücke zwischen Geschäftsanforderungen und Technologieteams und liefert oder ermöglicht innovative und konforme Lösungen, die einen greifbaren Geschäftswert schaffen.

Praktikumsübersicht

Wir suchen einen hoch motivierten Studenten, der sich dem Team von Customized Solutions für ein 12-monatiges Praktikum anschließt, das sich auf die Gestaltung und Implementierung der Agentic AI-Plattform der nächsten Generation von PWM konzentriert.

Diese strategische Initiative zielt darauf ab, Geschäftsanwendern sichere, skalierbare und verwaltete KI-Agenten zur Verfügung zu stellen, die in der Lage sind, Wissensfindung, Prozessautomatisierung, Entscheidungsunterstützung und Produktivitätssteigerung in PWM zu unterstützen.

Der Praktikant wird sowohl zu den Forschungs- als auch zu den Implementierungsaspekten der Plattform beitragen und akademische Arbeit mit praktischer Bereitstellung in einem realen Bankenumfeld kombinieren.

Deine Rolle

Agentic AI Platform Strategie und Architektur

• Bewerten Sie neue KI-Agent-Technologien, Frameworks und Muster.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Geschäfts-, IT-, Sicherheits- und Datenteams zusammen, um Anforderungen zu definieren.

• Unterstützen Sie das Design sicherer, skalierbarer und wiederverwendbarer Plattformkomponenten.

Governance und Risikomanagement

• Identifizieren Sie Richtlinien, Standards und Kontrollmechanismen für eine verantwortungsvolle KI-Einführung.

• Helfen Sie bei der Definition von Überwachungs-, Auditierbarkeits-, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen.

• Forschung Best Practices im Zusammenhang mit AI Governance in stark regulierten Umgebungen.

Umsetzung der Plattform

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Entwicklung und Konfiguration von KI-Agenten.

• Erstellen Sie Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts, die sich mit realen Business-Anwendungsfällen befassen.

• Integration von KI-Fähigkeiten in Unternehmensdatenquellen und Geschäftsanwendungen.

Forschung und Innovation

• Führen Sie akademische Forschung im Zusammenhang mit Agenten-KI-Systemen und Unternehmens-KI-Plattformen durch.

• Bewerten Sie Branchentrends und Benchmark-Lösungen im Finanzdienstleistungssektor.

• Übersetzen Sie Forschungsergebnisse in praktische Empfehlungen und Plattformverbesserungen.

Erwartete Leistungen

• Designempfehlungen für die PWM Agentic AI Platform Architektur.

• Vorschläge für einen KI-Governance-Rahmen und Umsetzungsleitlinien.

• Prototypen von KI-Agenten, die sich mit Business Use Cases und technischer Dokumentation befassen.

Bildung

• Informatik oder Software Engineering

• Künstliche Intelligenz

• Data Science

• Oder eine verwandte Disziplin

Technische Fähigkeiten

• KI und LLMs verstehen.

• Kenntnisse über Software-Architekturkonzepte.

• Vertrautheit mit Cloud-Technologien, APIs und Programmiersprachen

• Interesse an AI Governance und Sicherheit.

Persönliche Fähigkeiten

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Neugier und Bereitschaft, neue Technologien zu erlernen.

• Fähigkeit, effektiv mit technischen und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren.

• Autonome, organisierte und kollaborative Denkweise.

Was der Praktikant gewinnen wird

• Praktische Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer unternehmensweiten KI-Plattform in einer führenden Privatbank.

• Exposition gegenüber modernsten Agentic AI-Technologien und Governance-Praktiken.

• Gelegenheit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Experten aus den Bereichen Technologie, Sicherheit, Daten und Geschäftsbereiche.

• Fähigkeit, akademische Forschung in greifbare geschäftliche Auswirkungen umzuwandeln.

Votre équipe

L'équipe de PWM Customized Solutions permet d'innover au sein de Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) en aidant les utilisateurs commerciaux à exploiter les technologies modernes, y compris l'IA, les plateformes à faible code et les solutions de données. L'équipe agit comme un pont entre les besoins des entreprises et les équipes technologiques, fournissant ou permettant des solutions innovantes et conformes qui créent une valeur commerciale tangible.

Aperçu des stages

Nous recherchons un étudiant très motivé pour rejoindre l'équipe de Solutions Personnalisées pour un stage de 12 mois axé sur la conception et la mise en œuvre de la nouvelle génération de PWM Agentic AI Platform.

Cette initiative stratégique vise à fournir aux utilisateurs commerciaux des agents d'IA sûrs, évolutifs et réglementés capables de soutenir la découverte des connaissances, l'automatisation des processus, le soutien à la décision et l'amélioration de la productivité dans l'ensemble de la GP.

Le stagiaire contribuera à la fois aux aspects de la recherche et de la mise en oeuvre de la plateforme, combinant le travail académique et la prestation pratique dans un environnement bancaire réel.

Votre rôle

Stratégie et architecture de la plate-forme d'IA Agentique

• Évaluer les nouvelles technologies, cadres et modèles d'agents d'IA.

• Collaborer avec les équipes d'affaires, d'informatique, de sécurité et de données pour définir les exigences.

• Soutenir la conception de composants de plate-forme sécurisés, évolutives et réutilisables.

Gouvernance et gestion des risques

• Identifier les politiques, les normes et les mécanismes de contrôle pour une adoption responsable de l'IA.

• Aider à définir les exigences en matière de surveillance, de vérification, de sécurité et de conformité.

• Recherche des pratiques exemplaires liées à la gouvernance de l'IA dans des environnements hautement réglementés.

Mise en oeuvre de la plate-forme

• Participer au développement et à la configuration des agents d'IA.

• Construisez des prototypes et des preuves de concepts traitant de cas d'utilisation commerciale réelle.

• Intégrer les capacités d'IA aux sources de données d'entreprise et aux applications commerciales.

Recherche et innovation

• Mener des recherches académiques sur les systèmes d'IA agents et les plateformes d'IA d'entreprise.

• Évaluer les tendances de l'industrie et les solutions de référence adoptées dans le secteur des services financiers.

• Traduire les résultats de la recherche en recommandations pratiques et en améliorations de la plateforme.

Résultats escomptés

• Recommandations de conception pour l'architecture PWM Agentic AI Platform.

• Propositions de cadre de gouvernance d'IA et lignes directrices de mise en œuvre.

• Prototypes d'agents d'IA traitant des cas d'utilisation commerciale et de la documentation technique.

Votre profil

Éducation

• Génie informatique ou logiciel

• Intelligence artificielle

• Sciences des données

• Ou une discipline connexe

Compétences techniques

• Comprendre l'IA et les LLM.

• Connaissance des concepts d'architecture logicielle.

• Familiarité avec les technologies cloud, les API et les langages de programmation.

• Intérêt pour la gouvernance et la sécurité de l'IA.

Compétences personnelles

• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Curiosité et volonté d'apprendre les technologies émergentes.

• Capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants techniques et commerciaux.

• Une mentalité autonome, organisée et collaborative.

Ce que gagnera le stagiaire

• Expérience pratique de la construction d'une plate-forme d'IA de qualité entreprise dans une banque privée leader.

• Exposition aux technologies et aux pratiques de gouvernance de pointe de l'IA Agentic.

• Possibilité de collaborer avec des experts dans les domaines de la technologie, de la sécurité, des données et des affaires.

• Capacité de transformer la recherche universitaire en impact commercial tangible.

• Participer à une initiative hautement stratégique façonnant l'utilisation future de l'IA au sein de la Gestion de patrimoine.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

As a Client Relationship Officer in our Zurich office, you will be working in the German Speaking Switzerland Team, and you will be the point of entry for all operational requests from our Business Developers and clients. This is an 18 months fixed-term position with the possibility of extension and potential permanent employment.

You will bring your communication skills, your ability to work independently and your excellent interpersonal skills to a service-oriented team that will appreciate your motivation, high quality standards and networked thinking. Your organisational skills and thoughtful approach to your work will enable you to maintain an overview even in hectic situations. You will use your sense of responsibility, pleasant manner and outstanding client focus to support the team and our external clients.

Your role

Your responsibilities include the following:

• Main contact/support in the operational area in close cooperation with the responsible Senior CRM for independent asset managers in the German and Italian part of Switzerland
• Independent handling of telephone and written requests from independent asset managers in the day-to-day business
• Support in the development of existing client relations and in the process of onboarding new clients
• Receipt and processing of foreign exchange orders and payments
• Maintaining various administrative dossiers (e.g. corporate actions, IPOs, etc.)
• Opening, maintaining, and closing relationships with independent asset managers
• Support in account opening, pending management and document management
• Managing and updating our CRM tool
• Client meetings and support
• Correspondance to independent asset manager and with end clients

Your profile

• Completed banking apprenticeship or equivalent education, complemented by a minimum of 2-3 years of professional experience in the banking sector.
• Prior experience working with independent asset managers or international clients is considered a strong advantage
• Mastery of MS Office programmes (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Native level in German and good English and Italian skills are a must, French skills would be a plus
• Reliable and resilient, with a strong sense of responsibility, completion of the tasks and an ability to multi-task
• Ability to grasp things quickly
• Keen sense of initiative and independence
• Appreciate client contact
• Excellent interpersonal skills

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

As the successful candidate, you will be part of the Compliance Control Testing team, which is responsible for carrying out and developing control testing for all activities linked to anti-money laundering, cross-border activities, investor protection and market abuse monitoring. You will also be required to analyse Swiss, European and international legal and regulatory provisions, with a view to identifying specific risks as well as coming up with suggestions for improvement and compliance position statements linked to operational controls.

Your role

• Developing control testing in line with Group RCSA and ICS to ensure that all major compliance risks are covered by relevant and adequate controls (e.g. AML, investment suitability, cross-border, market abuse and shareholding disclosures, depository bank and conformity, US reporting, etc.).

• Formalising control testing results and proposing action plans and solutions to be shared with the first line of defense and other stakeholders.

• Interacting with the first line of defense control functions to understand the control framework in place and discuss potential attention points and action plans.
• Providing continuous ideas to improve the methodology in collaboration with other Group Compliance and Risk Group teams.
• Preparing KPIs and KRIs based on the controls performed.
• Acting as a key contact person for Internal/External Audit.

Your team

We are looking for an EPFL master’s student to join our four-person Customised Reporting team for a 12-month academic placement. The team produces highly bespoke investment reports and brings deep business expertise; you will complement this knowledge with strong engineering, automation and applied AI capabilities. Working closely with the Customised Solutions team and the relevant data teams, you will help transform a largely manual production model into robust, scalable and AI-enabled reporting solutions. Your work will directly contribute to reducing manual workload, capacity constraints and operational risk, while helping the team adopt modern tools and ways of working.

Your role

Key responsibilities

• Map the end-to-end customised reporting production model, including effort, tools, data flows, controls, risks, dependencies and failure points.

• Identify, assess and prioritise opportunities to industrialise and automate data aggregation, validation and reporting workflows, including the additional complexity created by external bank data.

• Work with Customised Reporting, Customised Solutions and data teams to design solutions aligned with existing architecture, data governance, security and control requirements.

• Design, develop, test and implement practical solutions and AI-enabled use cases for data extraction, anomaly detection, commentary generation and report production.

• Build robust End User Computing capabilities that empower reporting specialists while ensuring appropriate documentation, controls and maintainability.

• Deliver working tools and prototypes, a prioritised roadmap, documented procedures, user guidance and team training, ensuring an effective handover and a structured academic report.

Your profile

• EPFL student in the final year of a relevant master’s degree and eligible for a 12-month academic internship.

• Strong analytical, quantitative and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.

• Solid programming experience in Python or an equivalent language, together with skills in data manipulation, visualisation and workflow automation.

• Practical knowledge of applied AI, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and model evaluation.

• An understanding of the End User Computing lifecycle and familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, GitHub, Snowflake or cloud-based AI services would be advantageous.

• Curious, collaborative and hands-on, with the communication skills to work effectively across business and technology teams and support knowledge transfer.

• Knowledge of banking or investment reporting is welcome but not required.

La tua squadra

Siamo alla ricerca di uno studente del master EPFL per unirsi al nostro team di report personalizzati per un tirocinio accademico di 12 mesi. Il team produce report di investimento altamente su misura e porta competenze di business profonde; integrare questa conoscenza con forti capacità di ingegneria, automazione e AI applicate. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team Customised Solutions e con i relativi team di dati, vi aiuterà a trasformare un modello di produzione in soluzioni di reporting robuste, scalabili e abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà direttamente a ridurre il carico di lavoro manuale, i vincoli di capacità e il rischio operativo, aiutando il team ad adottare strumenti moderni e modi di lavoro.

Il tuo ruolo

Responsabilità chiave

• Mappare il modello di produzione di report personalizzati end-to-end, tra cui sforzo, strumenti, flussi di dati, controlli, rischi, dipendenze e punti di guasto.

• Identificare, valutare e privilegiare le opportunità per l'industrializzazione e l'automazione dei flussi di lavoro di aggregazione, convalida e reporting, compresa la complessità aggiuntiva creata da dati bancari esterni.

• Lavora con i team di report personalizzati, soluzioni personalizzate e dati per progettare soluzioni allineate ai requisiti di architettura, governance dei dati, sicurezza e controllo esistenti.

• Progettare, sviluppare, testare e implementare soluzioni pratiche e casi di utilizzo abilitati ad AI per l'estrazione dei dati, il rilevamento di anomalia, la generazione dei commenti e la produzione di report.

• Costruire robuste funzionalità di End User Computing che consentono agli specialisti di reporting, garantendo al tempo stesso documentazione, controlli e manutenbilità adeguate.

• Fornire strumenti di lavoro e prototipi, roadmap a priori, procedure documentate, guida degli utenti e formazione del team, assicurando una consegna efficace e un rapporto accademico strutturato.

Il tuo profilo

• Studente EPFL nell'ultimo anno di un master rilevante e idoneo per un tirocinio accademico di 12 mesi.

• Forte capacità analitiche, quantitative e problem solving, con la capacità di tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche pratiche.

• Esperienza di programmazione solida in Python o un linguaggio equivalente, insieme a competenze nella manipolazione dei dati, visualizzazione e automazione del flusso di lavoro.

• Conoscenza pratica dell'IA applicata, compresi i modelli di lingua di grandi dimensioni, la generazione aumentata e la valutazione dei modelli.

• Una comprensione del ciclo di vita End User Computing e la familiarità con Microsoft Copilot, GitHub, Snowflake o servizi AI basati su cloud sarebbe vantaggiosa.

• Curioso, collaborativo e pratico, con le competenze di comunicazione per lavorare efficacemente in team aziendali e tecnologici e supporto trasferimento di conoscenze.

• La conoscenza del reporting bancario o di investimento è benvenuta ma non necessaria.

Questa opportunità è intesa per gli studenti che completano una tesi di laurea richiesta dal loro programma accademico. Solo i candidati la cui laurea magistrale richiede uno stage sono idonei ad applicare.

Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten

• Entwerfen, Entwickeln, Testen und Implementieren von praktischen Lösungen und KI-fähigen Anwendungsfällen für Datenextraktion, Anomalieerkennung, Kommentierung und Berichtserstellung.

• Aufbau robuster Endbenutzer-Computing-Funktionen, die Reporting-Spezialisten befähigen und gleichzeitig eine angemessene Dokumentation, Kontrollen und Wartbarkeit gewährleisten.

• Liefern Sie Arbeitswerkzeuge und Prototypen, eine priorisierte Roadmap, dokumentierte Verfahren, Benutzerführung und Teamschulungen, um eine effektive Übergabe und einen strukturierten akademischen Bericht zu gewährleisten.

• EPFL-Student im letzten Jahr eines relevanten Master-Abschlusses und berechtigt zu einem 12-monatigen akademischen Praktikum.

• Starke analytische, quantitative und Problemlösungskompetenzen mit der Fähigkeit, Geschäftsanforderungen in praktische technische Lösungen umzusetzen.

L'équipe produit des rapports d'investissement sur mesure et apporte une expertise commerciale profonde; vous compléterez cette connaissance par de solides capacités d'ingénierie, d'automatisation et d'intelligence artificielle appliquée. En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Solutions personnalisées et les équipes de données concernées, vous aiderez à transformer un modèle de production largement manuel en solutions de reporting robustes, évolutives et adaptées à l'IA. • Planifier le modèle de production de rapports personnalisés de bout en bout, y compris les efforts, les outils, les flux de données, les contrôles, les risques, les dépendances et les points de défaillance.

• Identifier, évaluer et hiérarchiser les possibilités d'industrialisation et d'automatisation de l'agrégation, de la validation et de la communication des données, y compris la complexité supplémentaire créée par les données bancaires externes.

• Travailler avec des équipes de rapports personnalisés, de solutions personnalisées et de données pour concevoir des solutions alignées sur l'architecture existante, la gouvernance des données, la sécurité et les exigences de contrôle.

• Concevoir, développer, tester et mettre en œuvre des solutions pratiques et des cas d'utilisation de l'IA pour l'extraction de données, la détection d'anomalies, la production de commentaires et la production de rapports.

• Bâtir des capacités de calcul utilisateur final robustes qui responsabilisent les spécialistes des rapports tout en assurant la documentation, les contrôles et la maintenance appropriés.

• Fournir des outils de travail et des prototypes, une feuille de route hiérarchisée, des procédures documentées, des conseils aux utilisateurs et de la formation d'équipe, en assurant un transfert efficace et un rapport académique structuré.

Votre profil

• Etudiant de l'EPFL en dernière année d'un master pertinent et éligible à un stage académique de 12 mois.

• De solides compétences analytiques, quantitatives et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de traduire les besoins des entreprises en solutions techniques pratiques.

• Une solide expérience de programmation en Python ou dans un langage équivalent, ainsi que des compétences en manipulation de données, visualisation et automatisation du workflow.

• Connaissance pratique de l'intelligence artificielle appliquée, y compris les grands modèles linguistiques, la génération augmentée par récupération et l'évaluation des modèles.

• Une compréhension du cycle de vie de l'utilisateur final et de la familiarité avec les services d'IA basés sur Microsoft Copilot, GitHub, Snowflake ou Cloud serait avantageuse.

• Curieux, collaboratif et pratique, avec les compétences en communication pour travailler efficacement entre les équipes commerciales et technologiques et soutenir le transfert de connaissances.

• La connaissance des rapports bancaires ou d'investissement est bienvenue, mais elle n'est pas requise.

Cette possibilité est destinée aux étudiants qui terminent une thèse de maîtrise requise par leur programme académique. Seuls les candidats dont le diplôme de maîtrise exige un stage peuvent postuler.

jobs.description:
Your team

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Within the Reconciliation Department, you will join the Derivatives Reconciliation team, which is responsible for the daily reconciliation and monitoring of all listed and OTC derivatives transactions, including collateral and the cash movements related to these activities.

Your role

• Perform daily reconciliations and follow up of ETD and OTC derivatives transactions, positions, cash and collateral, and resolve breaks and pending items.
• Ensure the accuracy, completeness and consistency of all reconciliation outputs.
• Apply internal procedures and control standards in line with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Share relevant information with team members and stakeholders in a clear and timely manner.
• Handle queries related to derivatives reconciliations and provide professional support to internal and external counterparts.
• Identify and propose process improvements to streamline workflows and strengthen controls.
• Maintain accurate and up to date procedures, process documentation and reconciliation records.
• Investigate operational issues, contribute to root cause analyses and support corrective actions.
• Proactively identify, assess and escalate operational risks linked to derivatives reconciliations.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree in finance/economics or equivalent work experience in the financial industry.
• 3–6 years’ experience in banking operations or asset servicing; previous exposure to derivatives products and/or reconciliations is a strong asset.
• Strong interest in derivatives and good understanding of their mechanics (listed and OTC).
• Very good analytical skills, high attention to detail and ability to manage priorities and handle critical situations.
• Client and service oriented mindset, with the ability to understand stakeholder needs and provide high quality support.
• Strong team spirit, adaptability and willingness to learn in a changing technological and regulatory environment.
• Good digital literacy and interest in innovation; keen to use and suggest new technological solutions to improve processes.
• Fluent in English (spoken and written); any additional language is an advantage.

• Indaga le questioni operative, contribuisca ad analizzare e sostenere le azioni correttive.
• Identificare, valutare ed escalare i rischi operativi legati alle riconciliazione dei derivati.

• Mindset orientato al cliente e al servizio, con la capacità di comprendere le esigenze degli stakeholder e fornire un supporto di alta qualità.

Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 31 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo, attualmente con oltre 5.500 persone.

Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 220 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà del Partner offre un servizio completo per persone ricche e famiglie, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

Stiamo cercando di reclutare un Portfolio Construction & Analytics Intern. La vostra missione sarà di assistere la Piattaforma di Investimento PWM (“IP”) e l’unità di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale (“DPM”) nelle loro attività quotidiane e progetti strategici.

Il tuo ruolo

• Partecipate alla distribuzione di applicazioni di intelligenza artificiale come l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, l'apprendimento automatico e i modelli di lingua di grandi dimensioni nelle attività e nei processi IP PWM.
• Supporta le attività IP PWM attraverso la produzione di analisi quantitativa e la ricerca sulla costruzione del portafoglio.
• Contribuire attivamente a gruppi di lavoro e progetti relativi alle attività DPM/IP (allocazione di asset systematic, investimento di impatto/tematico, budget a rischio attivo).

Il tuo profilo

• Studente di Master in Finanza, Matematica o Scienza Informatica.
• Un certo interesse per i mercati finanziari e la tecnologia.
• Proficiente nei soliti strumenti IT (MS Office).
• Programmazione (Python preferibilmente) e capacità di apprendimento automatico richiesto.
• Familiarità con l'IA generativa e l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale e la loro applicazione ai compiti finanziari.
• Un forte giocatore di squadra in grado di lavorare tra le squadre PWM e le linee di business della banca.
• Comando perfetto di francese e/o inglese.

Data di inizio: febbraio/marzo 2027

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,500 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 220 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking to recruit an Portfolio Construction & Analytics Intern. Your mission will be to assist the PWM Investment Platform (“IP”) and Discretionary Portfolio Management unit (“DPM”) in their daily activities and strategic projects.

Your role

• Take part in deploying artificial intelligence applications such as natural language processing, machine learning and large language models in PWM IP activities and processes.
• Support PWM IP activities via production of quantitative analytics and portfolio construction research.
• Contribute actively to working groups and projects related to DPM/IP activities (systematic asset allocation, impact/thematic investing, active risk budgeting).

Your profile

• Master’s student in Finance, Mathematics or Computer Science.
• A definite interest in financial markets and technology.
• Proficient in the usual IT tools (MS Office).
• Programming (Python preferably) and machine learning skills required.
• Familiarity with generative AI and natural language processing and their application to financial tasks.
• A strong team player able to work across PWM teams and the bank’s business lines.
• Perfect command of French and/or English.

Start date: February/March 2027

This opportunity is intended for students completing a Master’s thesis required by their academic programme. Only candidates whose Master’s degree requires an internship are eligible to apply.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies
